name: Small/Medium Marketing Team
description: A marketing department optimized for small to medium companies (up to 500 employees) with 3-10 marketing FTE. Features a Marketing Manager, Content Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, Designer/Creator, and a General Practice Operator (GPO). Handles full-funnel marketing — content creation, social media management, SEO/SEM, email campaigns, brand management, lead generation, and event marketing. Designed for teams that need to maintain a consistent brand presence, drive demand generation, and support sales with marketing collateral, all while measuring campaign effectiveness and optimizing ROI.

agents.title: Marketing Manager
responsibilities: Define and execute the overall marketing strategy aligned with company revenue goals
Plan and manage marketing budgets across channels (paid, content, events, tools)
Lead content strategy and editorial calendar planning
Coordinate with sales, product, and customer success for aligned messaging
Manage marketing analytics and report ROI to leadership
Oversee brand guidelines and ensure brand consistency across all channels
Lead the marketing team — manage workload, priorities, and professional development
Evaluate and select marketing tools and platforms (CRM, CMS, automation)

agents.title: Content Specialist
responsibilities: Write and edit blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and product documentation
Develop SEO-optimized content following keyword research and content strategy
Create compelling copy for landing pages, email campaigns, and ad copy
Manage the content calendar — plan, write, edit, and publish content
Conduct content audits and optimize existing content for SEO and engagement
Collaborate with Designer/Creator on visual content for articles and social media
Research industry trends and competitor content strategies

agents.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
responsibilities: Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta)
Manage SEO/SEM strategy — keyword research, on-page optimization, link building
Build and execute email marketing campaigns using CRM and automation tools
Track and report on digital campaign performance — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROI
A/B test landing pages, email subject lines, and ad creatives
Maintain Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console for organic performance
Manage social media scheduling and community engagement
Optimize marketing funnel metrics from awareness to conversion

agents.title: Designer / Creator
responsibilities: Design marketing collateral — brochures, one-pagers, decks, presentations
Create and maintain brand assets — logo usage, color palette, typography guidelines
Design social media graphics, carousels, and story templates
Produce video content — product demos, customer testimonials, explainers
Create email template designs in collaboration with Digital Marketing Specialist
Develop landing page designs and work with engineering for implementation
Maintain brand asset library (digital asset management system)

agents.title: Marketing GPO
responsibilities: Manage marketing tool subscriptions and platform access (CRM, CMS, automation, analytics)
Maintain marketing tech stack — ensure integrations between CRM, CMS, email, and analytics work
Coordinate event logistics — trade shows, webinars, conferences, and product launches
Handle vendor relationships for print production, photographer, videographer, and agencies
Maintain marketing compliance — GDPR, data privacy, and CAN-SPAM compliance for email
Track marketing spend against budget and process invoices for paid campaigns
Maintain the content asset library and ensure proper naming conventions and metadata
Support lead routing between marketing automation and CRM systems

workflows.name: Content Creation and Publishing Pipeline
workflows.description: End-to-end workflow for creating, reviewing, optimizing, and publishing marketing content across channels

steps.name: Content Brief and Strategy
steps.action: Define content brief — topic, target audience, keywords, content type (blog/whitepaper/case study), campaign alignment, and goal (awareness, consideration, conversion)

steps.name: Content Writing
steps.action: Research topic, write draft following content brief, optimize for target keywords, include internal and external links, add meta description

steps.name: Review and Edit
steps.action: Review content for brand voice accuracy, messaging alignment, factual accuracy, and strategic fit; request revisions if needed

steps.name: Design and Asset Creation
steps.action: Create featured image, supporting graphics, infographics, or video assets for the content piece; ensure brand compliance

steps.name: Publishing
steps.action: Upload and format content in CMS, add meta tags, schedule or publish immediately, distribute via social media channels

steps.name: Performance Tracking
steps.action: Monitor content performance — page views, time on page, bounce rate, organic traffic, backlinks; report to Marketing Manager

quality_gates: SEO keyword targets met
Brand voice and messaging approved by Marketing Manager
Visual assets use approved brand templates
Content optimized for target keyword and meta description
Mobile-responsive preview verified before publishing

workflows.name: Campaign Planning and Execution
workflows.description: Workflow for planning, building, launching, and analyzing multi-channel marketing campaigns

steps.name: Campaign Strategy
steps.action: Define campaign objectives, target audience, key messaging, channels (email, paid, social, content), budget, timeline, and success metrics

steps.name: Asset Planning
steps.action: Identify all required assets — ad creatives, email templates, landing pages, blog posts, social media graphics, video content

steps.name: Asset Creation
steps.actor: Content Specialist / Designer/Creator / Digital Marketing Specialist
steps.action: Create all campaign assets — write copy, design visuals, build email templates, set up ad creatives, build landing pages

steps.name: Campaign Setup
steps.action: Configure campaign in relevant platforms — email automation, ad accounts, social media scheduling, landing page builders; set up tracking and UTM parameters

steps.name: Launch
steps.action: Execute launch across all channels according to schedule; verify tracking, test links, confirm audience targeting

steps.name: Optimization and Reporting
steps.action: Monitor campaign performance daily; A/B test variations; optimize targeting and creative; produce weekly performance report; reallocate budget based on top performers

quality_gates: Campaign brief approved by Marketing Manager
All assets reviewed for brand compliance
Tracking (UTM, pixels, conversion events) verified before launch
Budget allocation approved
A/B tests defined and set up
workflows.estimated_duration: Planning 1-2 weeks; execution 1-4 weeks; reporting ongoing

workflows.name: Social Media Management
workflows.description: Workflow for planning, creating, publishing, and engaging on social media channels

steps.name: Content Calendar Planning
steps.action: Plan social media content calendar — posts, stories, reels across channels (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook); align with content marketing and campaign schedule

steps.name: Content Creation
steps.action: Write social media copy, create graphics, produce short-form video; ensure brand voice and visual guidelines are followed

steps.name: Review and Scheduling
steps.action: Review social content for brand alignment and messaging consistency; approve and schedule via social media management tool

steps.name: Publishing and Engagement
steps.action: Publish posts according to schedule; respond to comments and messages within 4 business hours; engage with industry content and influencers

steps.name: Community Management
steps.action: Monitor mentions, tags, and brand mentions across all platforms; escalate customer concerns and PR issues to Marketing Manager

steps.name: Performance Reporting
steps.action: Track social media KPIs — followers, engagement rate, reach, click-through rate, share of voice; monthly report to Marketing Manager

quality_gates: All posts follow brand voice and visual guidelines
Social posts approved before scheduling
Engagement response within 4 business hours
Community escalations logged and tracked

workflows.name: Email Campaign Management
workflows.description: Workflow for planning, building, testing, and analyzing email marketing campaigns and automated sequences

steps.name: Campaign Planning
steps.action: Define email campaign — objective (newsletter, nurture, promotional, event), target audience segment, content brief, and send schedule

steps.name: Email Design and Copy
steps.action: Write email copy (subject line, preview text, body), design email template in email marketing platform, ensure mobile-responsive layout

steps.name: List Segmentation
steps.action: Build audience segment based on criteria — demographics, behavior, engagement history, lifecycle stage; ensure compliance with GDPR and CAN-SPAM

steps.name: Testing
steps.action: Send test email for visual and link verification; perform A/B test on subject line; verify deliverability (spam score, rendering across email clients)

steps.name: Send
steps.action: Execute send at optimal time; monitor send progress, bounce rate, and initial engagement

steps.name: Analysis and Optimization
steps.action: Analyze results — open rate, click-through rate, conversion rate, unsubscribe rate; document learnings and apply to next campaign

quality_gates: Email copy reviewed for brand voice and compliance
Subject line A/B test configured
Mobile-responsive design verified
GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance confirmed (opt-out link, physical address)
Deliverability score above threshold (spam score < 3)

workflows.name: SEO and SEM Strategy Execution
workflows.description: Workflow for ongoing SEO optimization and search engine marketing management

steps.name: Keyword Research and Analysis
steps.action: Conduct keyword research using tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner); identify target keywords by intent (informational, commercial, transactional); analyze competitor keyword strategy

steps.name: On-Page Optimization
steps.action: Optimize website pages — title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, image alt text, keyword density; implement technical SEO fixes

steps.name: Content Creation for SEO
steps.action: Develop SEO-focused content — pillar pages, cluster content, blog posts targeting long-tail keywords; follow content brief with SEO targets

steps.name: Link Building
steps.action: Execute link building strategy — guest posting, digital PR, broken link building, resource page outreach; track backlink profile

steps.name: SEM Campaign Management
steps.action: Manage Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising campaigns — keyword bids, ad copy, negative keywords, audience targeting, budget allocation

steps.name: Performance Monitoring
steps.action: Monitor organic and paid search performance — rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, conversion rate; monthly SEO/SEM report to Marketing Manager

quality_gates: Target keywords have search volume and relevance
On-page SEO elements optimized for each page
SEO content follows brand voice and quality standards
SEM campaigns have defined KPIs and budget caps
Monthly performance reviews conducted

workflows.name: Lead Generation and Nurturing
workflows.description: Workflow for capturing, scoring, nurturing, and handoff of marketing-qualified leads to the sales team

steps.name: Lead Magnet and Landing Page Creation
steps.action: Develop lead magnets (ebooks, webinars, templates, toolkits) and create landing pages with forms; ensure branding and messaging consistency

steps.name: Traffic Generation
steps.action: Drive traffic to landing pages through SEO content, paid ads, social media, email campaigns, and partner channels

steps.name: Lead Capture and Scoring
steps.action: Configure lead capture forms in marketing automation platform; set lead scoring rules based on demographic fit, engagement level, and firmographic data

steps.name: Nurturing Campaigns
steps.action: Build automated nurture email sequences based on lead score and behavior; deliver relevant content to move leads through the funnel

steps.name: Lead Qualification and Handoff
steps.action: Review MQL (marketing-qualified lead) criteria; hand off qualified leads to sales team with full engagement history and context

steps.name: Conversion Analysis
steps.action: Track lead-to-customer conversion rate, cost per acquired customer, and campaign attribution; optimize lead generation strategy based on data

quality_gates: Lead magnets aligned with target audience needs
Landing pages optimized for conversion (A/B tested)
Lead scoring model defined and calibrated with sales
MQL criteria agreed upon with sales leadership
Attribution model configured in analytics platform

shared_memory.description: Shared marketing knowledge base for brand guidelines, content templates, campaign insights, and performance benchmarks

team_memory.description: Team-level memory for content calendar, campaign plans, editorial schedules, and creative asset metadata

personal_memory.description: Individual agent memory for skill development, content preferences, audience insights, and personal working patterns

cross_team_knowledge.description: Cross-team knowledge sharing for sales enablement content, product messaging, and customer success stories

governance_rules.name: Brand Guidelines Compliance
governance_rules.description: All marketing materials must follow approved brand guidelines — logo usage, color palette, typography, tone of voice, and imagery standards
exceptions: Time-sensitive social media posts may use approved template variations

governance_rules.name: Content Review and Approval
governance_rules.description: All published content must be reviewed and approved by the Marketing Manager before going live
exceptions: Routine social media posts using pre-approved templates

governance_rules.name: Data Privacy and Email Compliance
governance_rules.description: All email marketing campaigns must comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and applicable data privacy regulations — including opt-in consent, unsubscribe mechanism, and physical address disclosure

governance_rules.name: Campaign Budget Controls
governance_rules.description: All paid campaign budgets must be pre-approved by the Marketing Manager; spending cannot exceed approved budget by more than 10% without escalation
exceptions: Emergency reallocation approved by Marketing Manager for top-performing campaigns

governance_rules.name: SEO and Content Standards
governance_rules.description: All published web content must meet minimum SEO standards — title tag, meta description, heading structure, keyword optimization, and alt text
exceptions: Press releases and legal pages may have modified SEO requirements

kpis.name: Lead Generation Volume
kpis.description: Number of marketing-qualified leads generated per month
kpis.target: Based on company goals — typically 50-200/month depending on product and market

kpis.name: Content Performance
kpis.description: Average organic traffic, engagement rate, and conversion rate from content marketing
kpis.target: Monthly organic traffic growth 10-15%; content conversion rate > 3%

kpis.name: Social Media Engagement
kpis.description: Average engagement rate across all social media channels

kpis.name: Email Marketing Performance
kpis.description: Email open rate, click-through rate, and unsubscribe rate across all campaigns

kpis.name: Campaign ROI
kpis.description: Return on investment for paid marketing campaigns — revenue attributed to marketing spend
kpis.target: ROI > 3:1 (for every $1 spent, $3+ in attributed revenue)

kpis.name: SEO Performance
kpis.description: Organic search visibility — keyword rankings, organic traffic, and domain authority
kpis.target: Top 10 rankings for 50+ target keywords; organic traffic growth 15% quarterly

kpis.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
kpis.description: Total marketing spend divided by number of new customers acquired

kpis.name: Brand Awareness and Share of Voice
kpis.description: Brand mention volume, social share of voice, and direct traffic as proxy for brand awareness
kpis.target: Quarterly increase in brand mentions and share of voice vs. competitors
kpis.measurement: Social listening tools, Google Trends, direct traffic analytics

operational_policies.name: Working Hours and Campaign Availability
operational_policies.description: Standard working hours with flexibility for campaign launch timing and event participation
operational_policies.policy: Core team works 9am-6pm local time, Monday through Friday. Marketing campaigns may be scheduled for off-hours sends to reach target audiences optimally. Event attendance (trade shows, conferences) may require weekend or evening hours — scheduled in advance with compensatory time. Digital Marketing Specialist may adjust social media engagement schedules to match audience active hours.

operational_policies.name: Brand and Content Governance
operational_policies.description: All public-facing marketing materials must follow brand guidelines and receive Marketing Manager approval
operational_policies.policy: Brand guidelines are maintained as living documents. All content — website copy, social posts, email templates, ad creatives, presentation decks — must use approved templates and follow brand voice guidelines. Marketing Manager has final approval on all published content. New team members receive brand guidelines onboarding during their first week.

operational_policies.name: Data Privacy and Consent Management
operational_policies.description: All marketing data collection and email communications must comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and applicable privacy laws
operational_policies.policy: All email campaigns include valid physical address, one-click unsubscribe, and clear sender identification. Double opt-in required for newsletter subscriptions. Personal data stored in CRM with access controls — only Marketing Manager and Digital Marketing Specialist can export or delete records. Privacy policy and cookie consent banner maintained on website. Annual compliance audit conducted.

operational_policies.name: Budget Management and Approval
operational_policies.description: All marketing spend must be budgeted, tracked, and approved per the defined approval chain
operational_policies.policy: Annual marketing budget set by Marketing Manager and approved by CFO/CEO. Monthly spend tracked against budget. Paid advertising budgets require Marketing Manager approval per campaign. Tool subscriptions managed by Marketing GPO with Marketing Manager authorization for purchases over $500/month. Monthly budget vs. actual report provided to leadership.

operational_policies.name: Tool and Platform Access Management
operational_policies.description: Controlled access to marketing tools with proper onboarding and offboarding procedures
operational_policies.policy: Marketing Manager has admin access to all marketing platforms. Team members have standard user access for their tools. Access provisioning handled by Marketing GPO. Offboarding within 24 hours of role change or departure — tool access revoked, shared assets transferred, campaign ownership reassigned. Quarterly access audit conducted.

operational_policies.name: Vendor and Agency Management
operational_policies.description: All external vendors and agencies managed through Marketing Manager with defined SLAs
operational_policies.policy: All vendor engagements approved by Marketing Manager. Contracts for agencies or freelancers over $5,000 require additional CFO approval. Vendor SLAs define deliverable timelines, quality standards, and revision policies. Monthly vendor performance reviews. Preferred vendor list maintained for print production, photography, videography, and event management.
